High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Reserve Pilot]] (a 2000 Decipher reprint, Dark Side: its copyright line reads "TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC." and its text carries the later wording "anything he pilots. When piloting Black 2, Black 3, or Black 4"; the 1996 A New Hope Limited printing reads "any starship he pilots. On Black 2, Black 3 or Black 4"), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>A New Hope/A New Hope Dark/Reserve Pilot.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeQ0NPZk5fVlFZRzQ/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Reserve Pilot.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,132 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b8815c87fc700a5ef348af5ed530e8d1d75e082df7df94b06bbb40ec1301d371</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.
